# The Kriya Yoga Path of Divine Living

### Swami Chidananda Giri • Yogoda Satsanga Society of India

Welcome and greetings. Swami Chidananda Giri details the beautiful, practical path of divine living through the scientific study of Kriya Yoga. Kriya is not just a technique; it is a full, harmonious way of life that elevates our relations, health, and spirit.

### Harmonizing the External and Internal World

Living a divine life means establishing a perfect equilibrium between our inner duties to God and our outer duties to family and society. By prioritizing our sadhana, we carry a portable temple of peace into our busy actions.

### Magnetizing our Entire Being

Regular daily practice of Kriya magnetizes our physical and subtle spinal column. Over time, the lower centers of restlessness are quieted, and the brain remains naturally anchored in the high state of peace and intuition.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Morning Devotion:** Establish your meditation routine before checking any phones or digital devices.
* **Never Skip:** Even if you can only sit for a short time, keep your scheduled hours sacred.
* **Work as Worship:** Offer the fruits of all actions to the Lord in your heart.
* **Speak Sweetly:** Cultivate gentle, loving speech with everyone you meet today.

May you stay beautifully attuned. Jai Guru!
